Lines 14 and 15 are the storage overage for August. They are billed a month behind, which is why they appear on this invoice and not the last one.

The underlying usage report is on the account, and I have held the invoice open until you confirm the two lines. If the overage is not yours, say so and it comes off before the run closes on the twentieth.

The third line you mentioned this morning is the same overage split across two cost centres, so it is one charge and not two.
